segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Good morning Marcus, this is Elena Marsh from OPSWAT technical support. I have your case about MetaDefender Endpoint open. Could you describe what you are seeing?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Good morning Elena. We rolled out MetaDefender Endpoint to our virtual desktops last month. Each morning many users show as unregistered in the management console, and the settings we pushed are gone after they log off and on again.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: To make sure I understand the setup, are the desktops persistent, or are they reset after each session?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: They are non-persistent. We run a Citrix-style VDI platform, and every logoff resets the desktop to the base image. A separate profile tool then restores the user profile from a file share at logon.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Thank you. Which version of Endpoint is installed in the base image?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Version 4.2.1. I confirmed it in the image this morning.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Could you read me what the Endpoint log says on a desktop that shows as unregistered?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Yes. There is a line saying the registration request failed because the certificate chain is not trusted. The issuer is our network team's SSL inspection proxy, not your management server.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: That tells us the connection is being intercepted before it reaches the management server. Is that inspection applied to every desktop in the pool?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: As far as I know, yes, every desktop. The network team manages it. I also noticed the profile tool attaches the profile a few seconds after the Endpoint service starts, so the settings file is not there yet when the service comes up.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Thank you, that is useful. The virtual desktop platform, the profile tool and the inspection proxy are all third-party products. They are outside OPSWAT's scope, so I cannot troubleshoot them. What I can do is confirm how Endpoint behaves and send you our documented guidance.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Understood. So you are saying this is not a defect in Endpoint?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: From what you have read to me, Endpoint appears to be behaving as designed. It rejects a certificate it does not trust, and it starts before the profile is available. I will confirm that against the full log. The platform behaviour is for your virtual desktop vendor and your network team.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Okay. I will pass this to our virtual desktop team and the network team. Should I still send you the full Endpoint log?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Yes please, the full log from one affected desktop. I will send the documented guidance for non-persistent desktops by end of day tomorrow.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: I will send the log today. Thank you, Elena.
